tasks.title: admin.provider_config + admin.email_log migrations
tasks.description: Extend server/src/config/migrations/adminMigration.ts to add two new tables: (1) admin.provider_config — id, kind ('llm'|'email'), provider ('openai'|'gemini'|'together'|'sendgrid'), model (nullable), api_key_enc (encrypted), from_email/from_name (nullable, email only), is_default (bool), is_active (bool), updated_by_admin_id, updated_at, created_at. Partial unique index ensures only one is_default per kind. (2) admin.email_log — id, to_email, subject, body_preview, sent_by_admin_id, recipient_user_id (nullable), provider ('sendgrid'|'fallback'), status ('sent'|'failed'), error TEXT, sent_at, created_at. Adds indexes on (kind, is_active) for provider_config and (sent_by_admin_id, sent_at DESC) for email_log.
acceptance_criteria: admin.provider_config exists with all listed columns and partial unique index on (kind) WHERE is_default=true
admin.email_log exists with all listed columns
Migration is idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS, DO blocks for constraints)
Existing admin.subscription_plans / admin.service_fee_config migrations still run cleanly

tasks.title: llmProviderService: OpenAI / Gemini / Together abstraction with env fallback
tasks.description: Create server/src/services/llmProviderService.ts that exposes (a) getActiveLlmProvider() which reads admin.provider_config WHERE kind='llm' AND is_default=true AND is_active=true and falls back to env-based Together AI when no DB row exists or the row has an empty key; (b) chatCompletion({ messages, maxTokens, jsonMode }) that internally dispatches to the OpenAI Chat Completions API, Google Gemini generateContent API, or Together /chat/completions based on provider; (c) testConnection(provider, apiKey, model) used by the admin UI to validate credentials with a minimal probe call. Each provider implements the same return shape { content, model, inputTokens, outputTokens }. Decrypts api_key_enc with a project-wide AES-256-GCM helper (PROVIDER_CONFIG_SECRET env). Existing togetherApiService.ts continues to work — this new service is the entry point for any AI feature that should respect admin overrides.
acceptance_criteria: Calling chatCompletion with provider=openai hits api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
Calling chatCompletion with provider=gemini hits generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent
Calling chatCompletion with provider=together hits config.together.baseUrl/chat/completions using the DB key (or env key fallback)
When no DB row exists, getActiveLlmProvider() returns the Together env defaults
testConnection() returns { success, latencyMs, error } and never throws

tasks.title: adminProviderService + emailService.sendPersonalEmail / sendTestEmail
tasks.description: Create server/src/services/adminProviderService.ts that wraps admin.provider_config CRUD: listProviders(kind), upsertProvider(kind, provider, payload), setDefault(id), softDelete(id). Encrypts api_key on save and never returns it in responses (instead returns a masked '****' + last 4 chars). Extend server/src/services/emailService.ts with (1) loadSendgridConfig() that reads admin.provider_config kind='email' provider='sendgrid' is_default=true, decrypts the key, and falls back to the env SendGrid config when not set, (2) sendPersonalEmail({ to, subject, body, fromAdmin }) — a BidWork-branded HTML wrapper around an admin-authored plain message that uses the active SendGrid config and logs the result to admin.email_log, and (3) sendTestEmail({ to, apiKey, fromEmail, fromName }) — uses the provided credentials directly (without persisting) so the admin can validate keys before saving.
acceptance_criteria: listProviders returns DB rows with api_key masked (****<last4>) and never the raw key
upsertProvider stores AES-256-GCM-encrypted api_key in api_key_enc column
setDefault is transactional — only one is_default=true per kind at any time
sendPersonalEmail writes an admin.email_log row with status sent or failed + error
sendTestEmail uses caller-provided credentials and returns success/error without persisting

tasks.title: /api/admin/providers/* and /api/admin/email/* endpoints
tasks.description: Add to server/src/routes/adminRoutes.ts (under authenticate + requireAdmin): GET /api/admin/providers?kind=llm|email — list saved providers (api_key masked); POST /api/admin/providers — upsert (body: kind, provider, model, api_key, from_email?, from_name?, is_default?); POST /api/admin/providers/:id/default — set default; DELETE /api/admin/providers/:id — soft delete; POST /api/admin/providers/test-llm (body: provider, model, api_key) — proxy to llmProviderService.testConnection without persisting; POST /api/admin/providers/test-email (body: provider, api_key, from_email, from_name, to) — proxy to emailService.sendTestEmail; POST /api/admin/users/:id/email (body: subject, body) — send a personal email to that user via the active email provider. Wire matching controller functions in server/src/controllers/adminController.ts (or a new adminProviderController.ts). Use a Zod-light validator block for each endpoint that rejects unknown providers / missing required fields with 400.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/admin/providers?kind=llm returns 200 with masked api_key strings
POST /api/admin/providers with valid payload returns 200 and the saved (masked) row
POST /api/admin/providers/test-llm with a bogus key returns 200 with { success:false, error }
POST /api/admin/providers/test-email sends a real email when SendGrid key is valid
POST /api/admin/users/:id/email returns 404 if user is missing and 200 with email_log id otherwise
All endpoints respond 403 when caller lacks admin role

tasks.title: Dashboard, Billings & ProvidersSetup pages in admin-client
tasks.description: Build three new pages in admin-client/src/pages/: (1) DashboardPage.tsx — landing page replacing /dashboard route as default after login. Shows KPI cards (Homeowners, Contractors, Skilled Labor, Active Projects, Accepted Bids this month, MRR placeholder) using a new GET /api/admin/stats summary plus reuse of existing endpoints. Card grid + small recent-activity feed. (2) BillingsPage.tsx — renames/extends SubscriptionsPage to show subscription stats + plan list + billing_history table with status pills, pagination. (3) ProvidersSetupPage.tsx — matches screen1.png: tab strip with 'LLM Provider' and 'Email Providers'. LLM tab has provider dropdown (OpenAI/Gemini/Together), model dropdown that switches per provider, password-style API key input pre-masked with last 4, Save Provider + Test Connection buttons, status pill showing current default ('openai · gpt-4.1-mini'). Email tab has provider dropdown (SendGrid only for now), API key, From Email, From Name, Save + Send test email (asks for a To address). Show a 'Where is this used?' info card on each tab. Update services/adminApi.ts with the new endpoints and App.tsx nav with /dashboard, /users, /billings, /providers, /service-fee, /rules, /analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Visiting / or /dashboard renders the new DashboardPage with KPI cards from real data (no console errors)
Sidebar has Dashboard, Users, Billings, Providers Setup, Service Fee, Bid Rules, Analytics in that order
Providers Setup LLM tab persists a new provider+model+key and shows masked key on reload
Providers Setup LLM tab 'Test Connection' shows green success / red error toast based on API response
Providers Setup Email tab 'Send test email' sends to admin's email and shows success/failure toast
All admin pages still require login (redirect to /login when no token)

tasks.title: Send-personal-email action on UsersPage
tasks.description: Add a 'Send Email' action button on every row of admin-client/src/pages/UsersPage.tsx (next to the existing Activate/Deactivate button). Clicking opens a modal with the user's name + email pre-filled (read-only), a Subject input, a multiline Body textarea, and Send / Cancel buttons. Calls POST /api/admin/users/:id/email and surfaces a toast (Sent / Failed) on response. While pending, button is disabled and shows spinner text. Modal closes on success after 1s. No fields persist between users.
acceptance_criteria: Send Email button appears for every user row regardless of role tab
Modal pre-fills the user's email read-only
Empty subject or empty body disables the Send button
Successful send shows toast 'Email sent to <email>' and closes modal
Failed send shows toast with the server's error string and leaves the modal open
